preconditions.description: n is the count of forbidden prefix products, m is the modulus, and they satisfy 0 ≤ n < m ≤ 200 000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in forbidden) if n > 0 else True
preconditions.description: If n > 0, the forbidden list contains n distinct integers between 0 and m - 1 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: forbidden == sorted(set(forbidden)) if n > 0 else True
preconditions.description: The forbidden list contains distinct integers (no duplicates).

postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is the integer k (length of sequence), and the second line is k space-separated integers representing the sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in sequence)
postconditions.description: Every element in the sequence is an integer between 0 and m - 1 (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: len(set(prefix_products)) == k and all(0 <= p < m for p in prefix_products)
postconditions.description: All prefix products modulo m are distinct, where prefix_products = [sequence[0] % m, (sequence[0] * sequence[1]) % m, ..., (product of entire sequence) % m].

postconditions.expression: all(p not in forbidden for p in prefix_products)
postconditions.description: No prefix product modulo m appears in the forbidden list.
The sequence length k is maximized, where max_possible_length(forbidden, m) is the largest possible k satisfying Q2, Q3, and Q4.
